title: They, Who on the Lord Rely
description: They, Who on the Lord Rely in Tonic Solfa to INNOCENTS, doh is D: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion, compiled by Samuel Longfellow and Samuel Johnson (Boston, 1848), as hymn 248, “He Shall Give His Angels Charge over Thee”, where the book credits them to Sp. of the Psalms.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Sevens (7.7.7.7) (7.7.7.7), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to INNOCENTS; any other Sevens (7.7.7.7) tune fits them as well.
underlay: They, who on the Lord re-ly, Safe-ly dwell, though dan-ger's nigh; Lo, His shel-tering wings are spread O'er each faith-ful ser-vant's head.

lines: They, who on the Lord rely,
Lo, His sheltering wings are spread
They shall be the Father's care;
Harmless flies the shaft by day,
Or in darkness wings its way.
When they wake, or when they sleep,
Death and danger may be near
Faith and love can never fear.

source: A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion (1848)
licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1848.
credits: Words anonymous, public domain, as printed in A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion (1848); set to INNOCENTS by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
